model.name: deep_idr_model
model.purpose: Intelligent Dead Reckoning (IDR) for predicting vehicle Velocity and Yaw Rate from smartphone IMU.

inference.compatibility: Compatible with standard ONNX Runtime environments (e.g., Android NNAPI, XNNPACK).

input.padding_behavior: If fewer than 10 samples are available at startup, Dev3 must pad the sequence (e.g., duplicate the first sample). The model strictly requires 10 timesteps.

features.name: DYN_ACC_MAG
features.description: Magnitude of the dynamic acceleration (raw acceleration minus gravity).

features.name: Yaw Rate
features.description: Predicted vehicle rotation rate around the vertical axis.
